title: Relationship / Pillar Interaction Professional Composition
objective: Project natal stem/branch relationships into a customer-readable pillar-interaction surface that binds relation type, pillar interface, Ten-God context, Day-Master carrying context and relationship-theme navigation without turning structural relations into deterministic event claims.
rendererRequirements: Show all four pillars as the structural interaction rail.
Show each detected relationship as a card with relation type, involved pillars, relationship theme and priority band.
Bridge each relationship to visible/hidden Ten-God context and Day-Master carrying context when the Day pillar is directly involved.
Provide theme navigation by pillar interface rather than deterministic family/spouse/career/event labels.
Keep combination presence distinct from transformation success and from lived-event outcome.
